title: The Monk Store
tagline: Add feature that will allow user ENS names to be resolved to wallet address for payments
description: This project adds a simple utility that enables users to be able to use Unlimit web payment portal with their ENS. Currently the user cannot simply pay using his ENS name. The address has to be input manually. This feature allows for the input to be parsed and then supplied to the web payment portal
how_its_made: Next.js, ethers, and Unlimit integration was used to create this project. I added a new feature for them so their overlay model can accept an ENS address. Unlimit payment portal was fun to use and thei documentation was helpful. I caught couple of bugs in the documentation, and the integration process
